properties.name: Framji Cowasji Tank
properties.source: Sharada Dwivedi & Rahul Mehrotra, Bombay: The Cities Within (1995)
properties.notes: Philanthropic tank near the Esplanade, filled in as the fort glacis was cleared. Location: Site opposite Metro Cinema at the Dhobi Talao junction; commemorative plaque survives (high confidence).

properties.name: Cowasji Patel Tank
properties.source: Sharada Dwivedi & Rahul Mehrotra, Bombay: The Cities Within (1995)
properties.notes: Filled in the late 19th century; the C.P. Tank locality is named after it. Location: Site is today's C.P. Tank Circle, Bhuleshwar/Girgaon (high confidence).

properties.name: Gowalia Tank
properties.source: Sharada Dwivedi & Rahul Mehrotra, Bombay: The Cities Within (1995)
properties.notes: Drained; the site is now August Kranti Maidan. Location: Site is today's August Kranti Maidan, Grant Road West (high confidence).

properties.name: Babula Tank
properties.source: Sharada Dwivedi & Rahul Mehrotra, Bombay: The Cities Within (1995)
properties.notes: Filled in; survives as Babula Tank Road. Location: Survives as Babula Tank Road along JJ Hospital's western wall (medium confidence).

properties.name: Mumbadevi Tank
properties.source: Sharada Dwivedi & Rahul Mehrotra, Bombay: The Cities Within (1995)
properties.notes: The old tank beside the Mumbadevi temple, filled in the 1870s-80s. Location: Tank fronted the surviving Mumbadevi Temple, Bhuleshwar; filled 1890s (high confidence).

properties.name: Dhobi Talao
properties.source: Sharada Dwivedi & Rahul Mehrotra, Bombay: The Cities Within (1995)
properties.notes: Filled; the Dhobi Talao junction keeps the name. Location: Locality name survives at the Metro Cinema junction (high confidence).

properties.name: Two Tanks (Do Tanki)
properties.source: Sharada Dwivedi & Rahul Mehrotra, Bombay: The Cities Within (1995)
properties.notes: Paired tanks filled in; survives as the Do Tanki locality. Location: Now the Do Tanki junction, Maulana Azad Rd; 'Two Tanks' bus stop survives (high confidence).

properties.name: Khara Talao
properties.source: Sharada Dwivedi & Rahul Mehrotra, Bombay: The Cities Within (1995)
properties.notes: Brackish tank near Null Bazaar, filled in. Location: Survives as Khara Tank Road, Kumbharwada near Null Bazaar (medium confidence).

properties.name: Cavel Tank
properties.source: Sharada Dwivedi & Rahul Mehrotra, Bombay: The Cities Within (1995)
properties.notes: Small neighbourhood tank, built over. Location: Cavel village locality centroid, Kalbadevi; no surviving marker (low confidence).

properties.name: Nawab Tank
properties.source: Sharada Dwivedi & Rahul Mehrotra, Bombay: The Cities Within (1995)
properties.notes: Filled in during 19th-century reclamation. Location: Survives as Nawab Tank Road, Mazgaon; site now a playground (medium confidence).

properties.name: Bandra Talao (Lake)
properties.source: Sharada Dwivedi & Rahul Mehrotra, Bombay: The Cities Within (1995)
properties.notes: Surviving tank near Bandra, much reduced and encroached. Location: Still exists as Swami Vivekanand Sarovar, S.V. Road, Bandra West (high confidence).

properties.name: Masjid Bandar tanks
properties.source: Sharada Dwivedi & Rahul Mehrotra, Bombay: The Cities Within (1995)
properties.notes: Cluster of small tanks largely lost to dense built fabric. Location: Locality centroid at Masjid railway station; one spring-fed tank survives in the Jama Masjid courtyard (medium confidence).

properties.name: Pydhonie tank
properties.source: Sharada Dwivedi & Rahul Mehrotra, Bombay: The Cities Within (1995)
properties.notes: The 'foot-washing' tank that gave Pydhonie its name; long since built over. Location: Pydhonie ('foot-wash') junction-area centroid near Mumbadevi (medium confidence).
